topics.name: Introduction to Rational Numbers
topics.summary: Understanding numbers that can be expressed in the form p by q where p and q are integers and q is not equal to zero.

topics.name: Properties of Rational Numbers
topics.summary: Exploring closure, commutative, associative, and distributive properties under addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

topics.name: Representation on Number Line
topics.summary: Graphically positioning rational numbers accurately on a straight number line.

topics.name: Rational Numbers Between Two Rational Numbers
topics.summary: Finding infinite rational numbers lying between any two given distinct rational numbers.

topics.name: Algebraic Expressions and Equations
topics.summary: Distinguishing between algebraic expressions and equations involving an equality sign.

topics.name: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
topics.summary: Applying balancing methods to isolate variables present on both sides of a linear equation.

topics.name: Reducing Equations to Simpler Form
topics.summary: Simplifying complex linear equations into standard forms before solving them.

topics.name: Word Problems on Linear Equations
topics.summary: Translating real-world scenarios into mathematical linear equations to find unknown values.

topics.name: Properties of Square Numbers
topics.summary: Identifying patterns and characteristic properties of numbers obtained by squaring integers.

topics.name: Finding Square Roots by Prime Factorization
topics.summary: Computing the square root of a number by breaking it down into its prime factors.

topics.name: Finding Square Roots by Division Method
topics.summary: Using the long division algorithm to determine the square root of larger numbers.

topics.name: Square Roots of Decimals
topics.summary: Calculating square roots for numbers containing decimal points using appropriate grouping methods.

topics.name: Powers with Negative Exponents
topics.summary: Understanding how negative exponents represent the reciprocal of the base raised to a positive power.

topics.name: Laws of Exponents
topics.summary: Applying algebraic rules for multiplying and dividing terms with the same or different bases and exponents.

topics.name: Standard Form of Numbers
topics.summary: Expressing very large or very small numbers compactly using scientific notation with powers of ten.

topics.name: Comparing Very Large and Very Small Numbers
topics.summary: Utilizing standard form representations to compare magnitudes of extreme values.
